owner_direction: Continue after reported provider rejection; original organization and Free-tier scope unchanged
engineering_review: Known rejected/non-uncertain receipt; no evidence of authentication, permission, model-unavailable or 429 response. Exact status/body unavailable, root cause unknown. Continue untouched cases without retrying or changing failed case.
limits: One logical case per batch; any new failure, active/uncertain usage, drift or quota block halts. Original HTTP retry configuration unchanged.
observation: Record only HTTP integer status and timestamp; no bodies, headers, credentials or request content. Hook does not change payload or response handling.
preserve: All636 baseline terminal entries,including rejection; full usage and request count; original frozen engine/profile/experiment; cache amendment001 and source; same account/ledger/ceilings/prices.
provenance_limit: Recovery controller and metadata hook are external operational changes, not covered by original engine freeze. Read new snapshots with both amendments and their per-batch sidecars. Completion does not erase the failed case or guarantee acceptance.
